Introduction

TIOT, short for TIME IS OUR TURN, is a five-member boy group under Redstart ENM. They debuted on April 22, 2024, with the mini album Kick-Start.

On August 1, 2025, it was announced that REDSTART BOYS had changed their name to TIOT. They released their pre-debut mini album, Frame the Blueprint: Prelude to Possibilities on August 23.
